messages:
marta: Quick ask from shiproom: we need a defensible tenant-cookie + decay plan for the upcoming model swap. Focus: minimize thrash, enable shadow AB probes, and define soft-fallback ownership. Thoughts?
kevin: Proposal sketch: cohort selection by tenant fraction + per-tenant cookie (48h). Start 3% tenants, bump to 10% after validations, then up to 25% if stable. Per-tenant cap 50rps.
saira: Add a decay budget: if a tenant triggers circuit >2 times in 30m, drop its exposure to 0 and start a 2h cooldown. Also track a per-tenant "exposure_score" to avoid flip-flopping.
ops-bot: runbook reminder: any plan that could affect private tenants' latency SLA requires oncall pinned and runbook attached. Use /runbook attach model-swap-rollout.
kevin: Shadow AB probe: during warmup enable stealth shadow for 2% of sessions in the cohort (capture outputs but don't return) and run hallucination + safety evals. If AB delta > +1.0 hallucination points on the eval set, auto-hold.
ml-eval: I'll supply 12 curated prompts + 6 customer-specific probes. We'll compute a simple hallucination score and false-positives per 1k tokens.
legal: For private EU tenants, ensure consent metadata is logged for tenants that opted into early access: tag metrics with tenant.opt_in=true. Keep logs in-region.
kevin: Flag proto (compact):
```
flags.model_swap.cookie_decay_v1 = {
  cohort_fraction: 0.03,
  per_tenant_cookie_ttl: "48h",
  per_tenant_cap_rps: 50,
  warmup_mins: 20,
  bump_policy: ["0.10 after 60m","0.25 after 4h"],
  decay_policy: {circuit_trips: 2, window_mins: 30, cooldown_mins: 120},
  shadow_fraction: 0.02,
  ab_probe_size: 1500,
  fallback_chain: ["quantized","token_cap_256","prompt_simplify","global_kill"],
  telemetry_gates: ["kms_ok","p95_gate","ab_hallucination"],
  kill_switch_latency_target_s: 60
}
```
saira: Telemetry gate defs: kms_ok = KMS health check pass for 10m prior; p95_gate = p95 <= baseline*1.25 over 15m; ab_hallucination = AB cohort delta <= +1.0.
ops-bot: scheduled-task: kms-health-check at 1800004400. Fail -> hold + alert #eng-oncall.
kevin: Ownership: infra owns fallback variants (quantized/token caps). Product owns AB probes and approval. ML infra implements per-tenant cookie logic. Security must sign canary manifest before auto-bump.
deploy-bot: deploy reminder: /deploy canary --requires-approvals product,security.
ml-eval: One more: prefer 2-stage AB evaluation: quick sanity on small eval set at +30m, then full 1500-sess AB at +3h before large bump.
marta: Action items:
- kevin: implement flag + cookie TTL + kill-switch hook (owner)
- saira: implement decay budget + per-tenant exposure tracker (owner)
- ml-eval: prepare eval prompts and scoring harness (owner)
- ops: confirm KMS preflight scheduling and per-tenant cap enforcement (owner)
- legal: confirm telemetry opt-in tagging and in-region retention (owner)
Timeline: kms-check 1800004400, warmup 20m, quick sanity at +30m, AB full at +3h, big bump after AB pass.
marta: If no objections to 3%->10%->25% cadence and 2-trip circuit trigger, :thumbsup: to proceed.
kevin: :thumbsup:
saira: :thumbsup:
legal: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: /deploy canary --requires-approvals product,security
marta: Closing thread; I'll draft shiproom summary and attach runbook. Reopen here if approvals or KMS fail.
